task.title: Troubleshooting OpenShift Container Platform and Kubernetes Builds
task.shortdesc: To troubleshoot OpenShift Container Platform and Kubernetes builds in Red Hat Quay, you can create a port forwarding tunnel to the builder pod and access it via SSH. Check the quay-builder service logs to diagnose build issues.
